g.text: Compute capacity of AI data centers, by company

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: the same Epoch view broken out by owner — who has actually built the 86 tracked sites. Observed data only;

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the 81 future-dated milestones in the source are excluded, so the series stops at the 2026-09-08 snapshot rather than

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — data_centers.csv + data_center_timelines.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published data centers documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Owner shares sum to Epoch's published total of 13.9M exactly. Ownership is the entity that built and holds the site, which is often

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: not the entity using it - see the owner-versus-user chart in Derived Analysis. "Unknown" is Epoch's own label where ownership is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: unattributed, not a residual we computed. Compute is derived by Epoch from IT power and the chip mix judged most likely to be

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: installed, except where a site's chips are reported. It is modelled, not a hardware inventory. Epoch put this database's coverage of

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: global deployed AI compute at 46% at the end of June 2026 (90% CI 26-79%), strongest for the largest sites, so every share is a share

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: of what Epoch tracks, not of the world.
